default_input_policy.description: Default policy for the INPUT chain. Can be ACCEPT, DROP, or REJECT.

default_forward_policy.description: Default policy for the FORWARD chain. Can be ACCEPT, DROP, or REJECT.

default_output_policy.description: Default policy for the OUTPUT chain. Can be ACCEPT, DROP, or REJECT.

log_drops.description: Enable logging of packets that match no specific rule before hitting the default policy.

log_prefix.description: Prefix string for iptables LOG target.

ssh_sources.description: List of source IPs or networks allowed to access SSH (port 22). Empty list means no access or handled by custom rules.

http_sources.description: List of source IPs or networks allowed to access HTTP (port 80).

https_sources.description: List of source IPs or networks allowed to access HTTPS (port 443).

custom_input_rules.description: List of additional iptables rule strings to append to INPUT chain.

custom_forward_rules.description: List of additional iptables rule strings to append to FORWARD chain.

masquerade_enabled.description: Enable NAT masquerading for outbound traffic.

masquerade_iface.description: The network interface to use for masquerading.
